name: Spherical Harmonics and Spherical Gaussians for Radiance Transfer
aliases: Spherical Harmonics (SH) and Spherical Gaussians (SG) for Radiance Transfer
definition: Approximation methods for radiance transfer used in real-time or long-rendering scenarios to avoid expensive on-the-fly calculations of the light transport equation.
summary: Spherical Harmonics and Spherical Gaussians approximate radiance transfer to avoid expensive light transport calculations, using SH for diffuse surfaces and SG for high-frequency glossy terms.
